one_sentence_summary: Evaluate a toy cache-routing policy on synthetic traces and record safe, source-grounded project memory.
goal: Demonstrate Project Memory Agent output using a fully synthetic cache-routing example.
current_stage: Synthetic fixture complete; ready for documentation examples.
confirmed_findings: The toy router sends small requests to the fast cache path in the synthetic trace.
The fallback path is triggered when the synthetic request size exceeds the configured threshold.
tentative_hypotheses: A lower threshold may reduce tail latency on bursty synthetic traces.
important_decisions: Use synthetic data only for public examples.
failed_attempts: A previous threshold of 128 units overloaded the fast path in the toy trace.
open_questions: Which threshold best balances fast-path load and fallback frequency in the synthetic trace?
next_actions: Run the synthetic trace with thresholds of 64, 96, and 128 units.
Record whether fallback frequency changes across the synthetic thresholds.
